answers.answer_text: For a VC-backed GmbH, choose a tax advisor with DATEV, payroll, investor reporting, and financing experience. Avoid generalist advisors without startup experience.
answers.trust_evidence: Helpful for 12 founders. Verified in Tax/Admin by 8 founders.

answers.answer_text: For GmbH incorporation as a non-EU founder, work with a notary early and a lawyer who has done founder agreements and cap tables. Budget 2-3 weeks for the process.
answers.trust_evidence: Helpful for 9 founders. Recommended by 4 verified founders at your stage.

answers.answer_text: For Anmeldung, book a Bürgeramt appointment the moment you have a rental contract; slots disappear fast. You need the Wohnungsgeberbestätigung from your landlord.
answers.trust_evidence: Helpful for 21 founders. One of the most-confirmed answers in Relocation.

answers.answer_text: For pre-seed funding in Berlin, start with angels in your sector before institutional VCs. Warm intros convert far better than cold outreach; aim for a clean SAFE or convertible.
answers.trust_evidence: Helpful for 14 founders. Verified in Funding.

answers.answer_text: For early coworking that connects you to the ecosystem, pick a space with an active founder community and events, not just desks. Ask about their startup network before signing.
answers.trust_evidence: Helpful for 7 founders. Trusted coworking node.
